name: Spatula
flavor: Standard issue. Heavy-duty. Has flipped ten thousand burgers and one regret.

name: Plunger
flavor: The hero Dad always needed. The hero he never acknowledged.

name: Leaf Rake
flavor: Technically seasonal. Violence is not.

name: Caulk Gun
flavor: Point at enemy. Express opinions firmly.

name: Mini Blowtorch
flavor: For the creme brulee. And now this.

name: Steel-Toe Boot
flavor: OSHA approved. OSHA impressed.

name: Broom Handle
flavor: The broom part is gone. The handle remains. The handle is enough.

name: The Flame Spatula
flavor: OSHA has questions. The burgers do not.

name: Half a Brick
flavor: Found in the yard. Origin unknown. Purposes: many.

name: The Leafblight Devastator
flavor: An ancient wind-cannon said to strip entire kingdoms of loose paperwork and decorative mulch. Wielded annually during the Season of Fallen Oaks.

name: Grondar's Measure of Reckoning
flavor: A cursed tape measure that extends infinitely until reality itself is found to be 'just a quarter-inch off.'

name: The Socketweaver's Doomchain
flavor: A legendary ratchet capable of summoning exactly the socket size you don't have. Entire civilizations have collapsed searching for the missing 10mm.

name: The Pressure Wand of Aquatic Judgment
flavor: A hydrokinetic staff that reveals the true color of all surfaces and accidentally strips paint from neighboring dimensions.

name: Orbital Sander of Reckoning
flavor: Spins at 12,000 RPM. Intended for drywall. The enemy counts as drywall now.

name: The Extension Cord of Endless Horizons
flavor: A serpentine cable-beast stretching across battlefields, driveways, and occasionally international borders.

name: The Ladder of Ascendant Peril
flavor: A towering relic whose wielders gain temporary flight, followed by immediate wisdom regarding gravity.

name: The Orbital Edger of Property-Line Wars
flavor: Said to carve trenches so precise they have started blood feuds lasting generations.

name: The Hexhammer of Weekend Intentions
flavor: Every strike repairs one thing and reveals three new projects.

name: The Great PTO Reaper
flavor: A chainsaw of mythic power whose roar awakens ancient spirits and prompts neighbors to inspect trees they weren't worried about five minutes earlier.

name: The Justin Case Bucket of Miscellaneous Screws
flavor: Contains every fastener required to save the realm except the one currently needed.

name: The Shop-Vac of Infinite Suction
flavor: A roaring drum-beast that inhales sawdust, loose screws, and the occasional sock. Filter status: unknown for years.

name: The Pizza Cutter of a Thousand Slices
flavor: A wheeled blade forged for Friday nights. Cuts crust, cardboard, and ambition in perfectly uneven portions.

name: The Snow Shovel of Seasonal Vengeance
flavor: Lives in the garage eleven months a year, dreaming of the twelfth. The driveway remembers. So does his back.

name: The Backyard Tiki Torch of Ambient Menace
flavor: Citronella-scented and faintly threatening. Keeps mosquitoes, raccoons, and party guests at a respectful distance.

name: The Garden Hose of Unspooling Doom
flavor: A serpent that kinks at the precise moment of maximum need. Never re
